title: Email news
listIntro: AFC's own news by email, sent only to people who said yes to it. Every email carries an Unsubscribe link, and the tracker shows what happened to it.
emptyBody: Press New email to write the first one.
templateSaved: Saved as a template. It is in Start from, for every admin who writes email news.
templateSavedFrom: {name} is now a template. Find it in Start from when you write an email.
templatesEmpty: No templates yet. Save an email as a template from its menu, or from a sent email here.
everyoneChip: Everyone who said yes to email news
filters.help: Filters narrow each other: Tier 1 plus Nigeria means Tier 1 players in Nigeria. Teams and players in the To line are added on top.
count.pick: Add a team or a player, or use Filters.
count.everyone: {yes} people get it: everyone who said yes to email news, of {total} accounts.
count.some: {yes} of {total, plural, one {{totalText} account picked} other {{totalText} accounts picked}} will get it.
reason.no_consent: has not said yes to email news
reason.bounced: the address bounced, so it is never mailed again
reason.inactive: the account is deleted or suspended
teamLeft: {left} of {total} left out (not said yes, unsubscribed or bounced)
languageHint: Each language is its own copy. Readers get theirs; anyone else gets English.
subject: Subject
previewLineHint: The grey line inboxes show after the subject (optional)
noVersion: No {lang} version yet, so {lang} readers get the English one.
tips.title: What email apps allow
tips.fonts: Fonts: a font from the list shows where the reader's phone or computer has it, otherwise the next one in its family (Arial for DM Sans in Gmail and Outlook). An uploaded font shows in Apple Mail and iPhone Mail; other apps show the fallback you pick. Words inside a designed picture look the same everywhere.
tips.pictures: Pictures go through AFC's own checks (JPEG, PNG or WEBP, up to 5 MB, saved again by the server, shrunk to 1200 px) and are served from AFC. Some apps hide pictures until the reader allows them, so give each one a description and keep anything important in the words.
tips.video: Video does not play inside an email in most apps. Use a picture that links to the video.
tips.length: Gmail cuts very long emails and shows View entire message. Keep it short.
sendTo: Send to {n, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
draftSaved: Draft saved. It is in Email news.
sending: Sending to {nText} {n, plural, one {person} other {people}}. Follow it here.
useOwnDesign: Use your own HTML design instead
seeAsSent: See it as it is sent
seeAsSentHint: Exactly what a reader in this language gets, without tracking. {kb} KB.
needsEnglish: Write the English email first: everyone without their own language gets it.
confirmSend.title: Send to {nText} {n, plural, one {person} other {people}}?
confirmSend.body: It goes out in the background at the rate Amazon allows for AFC, and you can stop it from the tracker. A sent email cannot be changed.
confirmStart.title: Replace what you have written?
confirmStart.body: The subject, preview line, email and colours of every language are replaced. Who gets it stays as it is.
confirmDiscard.title: Delete this draft?
confirmDiscard.body: The draft and everything in it is deleted. This cannot be undone.
fmt.title: Title
fmt.heading: Heading
insert.design: Colours and fonts of the whole email
picked.description: Description, shown when pictures are hidden
picked.bakedNote: Transparency is baked into the picture when it is sent, so every email app shows it the same.
picked.designedNote: Sent as one picture; its words are its description, so keep anything important in the email's words too.
picked.linkInvalid: A link starts with https:// (or mailto: for an email address).
design.title: Colours and fonts of the whole email
design.intro: One look for the whole email, in every language. Colours and sizes show in every email app.
design.colour.head: Headings
design.uploadHint: WOFF2, WOFF, TTF or OTF, up to 5 MB, checked like every font AFC takes.
design.fallback: {font}, when an app cannot show it
design.uploadedNote: Uploaded fonts show in Apple Mail and iPhone Mail; other apps, Gmail and Outlook among them, show the fallback you pick. In a designed picture they show everywhere, because it is sent as a picture.
designed.title: Designed picture
designed.hint: Drag a picture or words to any spot (arrow keys nudge the one you picked). Choose what sits in front. It is sent as one picture, because email apps cannot layer pictures and words, and its words become the picture's description.
designed.pressOne: Press a picture or words on the board to change it.
designed.pictureMissing: A picture of this design could not be loaded. Add it again.
own.title: Your own design, {lang}
own.intro: Made the email in another email tool, or had a designer make it? Upload the finished design for this language: an HTML file, a ZIP with the HTML and its pictures, or MJML, which AFC turns into HTML. A language with no design of its own gets the English one.
own.dropHint: or drop it here. HTML, ZIP or MJML, up to 2 MB.
own.usesEnglish: No {lang} design yet, so {lang} readers get the English one.
own.checksTitle: What AFC did to it before it can be sent
own.checks.removedN: {n, plural, one {# taken out (email apps would block it anyway)} other {# taken out (email apps would block them anyway)}}
own.checks.linksN: {n, plural, one {# link, counted} other {# links, each counted}} for the tracker when clicked
own.checks.packed: {n, plural, one {# picture packed inside the file, moved to AFC's server} other {# pictures packed inside the file, moved to AFC's server}} (most email apps do not show pictures packed into an email).
own.checks.web: {n, plural, one {# picture from a web address, left as it is (the reader's email app loads it).} other {# pictures from web addresses, left as they are (the reader's email app loads them).}}
own.checks.dropped: {n, plural, one {# picture could not be read and was removed (its description stays).} other {# pictures could not be read and were removed (their descriptions stay).}}
own.checks.footerAdded: AFC's own line is added at the bottom of every design
own.checks.sizeOf: {kb} KB of the {clip} KB Gmail shows before it cuts the email
own.empty: Upload a design to see it here.
tracker.saveDesign: Save this design as a template
tracker.opensNote: Opened is a soft number: some mail apps load every picture, so they count as opened. Clicked is the honest one.
errors.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.head_admin_required: Only head admins can use email news.
errors.mail_campaign_not_draft: This email has already been sent, so it cannot be changed.
errors.mail_campaign_not_sending: This email is not going out any more.
errors.mail_english_required: Write the English email and its subject first: everyone without their own language gets it.
errors.mail_version_incomplete_fr: The French version needs both a subject and an email, or neither.
errors.mail_version_incomplete_pt: The Portuguese version needs both a subject and an email, or neither.
errors.mail_audience_empty: Choose who should get it: add a team or a player, use Filters, or press Everyone.
errors.mail_audience_invalid: That audience could not be read.
errors.mail_no_recipients: Nobody you picked has said yes to email news yet, so there is nobody to send it to.
errors.mail_admin_no_email: Your account has no email address, so the test has nowhere to go.
errors.mail_test_refused: The mail server refused the test. Try again in a minute.
errors.mail_ses_not_authorized: Amazon SES refused the email: the SMTP user is not allowed to send. In AWS, open IAM, the SMTP user, and allow ses:SendRawEmail.
errors.mail_ses_unverified: Amazon SES refused the email: while the account is in the sandbox, the sender and the recipient must both be verified in SES.
errors.mail_ses_throttled: Amazon SES is limiting how fast AFC can send. Try again in a minute.
errors.mail_ses_login_refused: Amazon SES did not accept the SMTP user name or password set on the server.
errors.mail_not_set_up: Sending email is not set up on the server yet. Drafts, templates and previews work; sending waits for the Amazon SES steps.
errors.mail_doc_invalid: The email could not be read. Copy your words, start again and paste them.
errors.mail_doc_too_big: The email is too long. Make it shorter, or split it into two emails.
errors.mail_doc_too_deep: The email has lists inside lists too deep. Make it flatter.
errors.mail_style_invalid: The colours and fonts could not be read.
errors.mail_mode_invalid: That way of making an email does not exist.
errors.mail_field_invalid: One of the fields could not be read.
errors.mail_field_too_long: A subject or preview line is too long.
errors.mail_language_invalid: That language is not one AFC sends in.
errors.mail_paging_invalid: That page could not be loaded.
errors.mail_not_an_image: That file is not a picture AFC can use (JPEG, PNG, WEBP or GIF).
errors.mail_image_too_large: That picture is bigger than 5 MB.
errors.mail_not_a_font: That is not a font file (WOFF2, WOFF, TTF or OTF).
errors.mail_font_too_large: That font is bigger than 5 MB.
errors.mail_asset_kind_invalid: That kind of file cannot be added.
errors.mail_asset_not_found: That file is no longer on AFC.
errors.mail_design_too_big: That file is bigger than 2 MB. Make its pictures smaller, or put them in a ZIP beside the HTML.
errors.mail_design_wrong_type: That file is not HTML, ZIP or MJML.
errors.mail_design_unreadable: That ZIP file could not be opened.
errors.mail_design_too_many_files: That ZIP holds too many files (200 at most).
errors.mail_design_no_html: There is no HTML file in that ZIP.
errors.mail_design_mjml_unavailable: MJML cannot be turned into HTML yet. Upload the HTML your tool exports.
errors.mail_design_mjml_invalid: That MJML could not be turned into HTML. Check it in your email tool first.
errors.mail_design_mjml_include: That MJML pulls in other files (mj-include), which AFC does not read. Put it all in one MJML file.
errors.mail_design_upload_only: Upload the design with Choose a file.
